# Mohamed Amgad Khater

> Security R&D Tech Lead at Cyshield. Builds AI-native security products (an application security platform, agentic SOC systems, and the security architecture behind an AI-powered WAF), the model infrastructure they run on, and the evaluation work that measures them. Offensive security background: OSAI, OSWE, eWPTXv2, eCPPTv2, eMAPT, published CVEs, and disclosures through HackerOne and Bugcrowd.

## Profile

- [About](https://amgad.io/about/): current work, how the products connect, evaluation and model infrastructure, earlier career
- [Resume](https://amgad.io/resume/): experience, projects, skills, certifications, CVEs and awards
- [Certifications](https://amgad.io/certificates/): every certification with a verification link

## Vulnerability research

- [CVE-2026-108481](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/patreon-connect/vulnerability/wordpress-patreon-wordpress-plugin-1-10-0-cross-site-request-forgery-csrf-vulnerability): cross-site request forgery in the Patreon WordPress plugin
- [CVE-2026-104803](https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/wordpress-plugins/wpcom-member/wpcom-member-1727-unauthenticated-authentication-bypass-via-uuid-and-code-parameters-on-social-login-callback): unauthenticated authentication bypass in the WPCOM Member WordPress plugin
- [CVE-2026-105059](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/delete-all-comments-of-website/vulnerability/wordpress-delete-all-comments-of-wordpress-plugin-7-1-broken-access-control-vulnerability): broken access control in the Delete All Comments WordPress plugin
- [CVE-2026-93620](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/payplus-payment-gateway/vulnerability/wordpress-payplus-payment-gateway-plugin-8-2-5-broken-access-control-vulnerability): broken access control in the PayPlus Payment Gateway WordPress plugin
- [CVE-2017-1000058](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-1000058): stored XSS in Chevereto CMS
